item.title: Port Vale reach FA Cup fifth round for first time in 30 years
item.description: League One strugglers Port Vale advanced to the FA Cup fifth round for the first time since 1996 after Ben Waine struck an extra‑time winner to defeat Bristol City at Vale Park. Waine decided the tie with eight minutes remaining, latching onto Andre Gray’s through-ball, rounding Joe Lumley and finishing from a tight angle to reward a disciplined and determined Vale performance.
